column1: # Case table for substrate/.github/workflows/caixa-tlisp-auto-release.yml
# TAB-separated: <name> <context k=v;k=v> <expect-run csv> <expect-skip csv>
# WHAT THIS WORKFLOW IS, AND WHY ITS PRIVACY ROW READS THE OTHER WAY.
# The 2026-08-08 graphql-synthesizer silent-no-publish came from a job guarded
# `&& !github.event.repository.private`: a private repo bumped, tagged, pushed,
# published nothing, and reported success. This workflow carries the same
# `github.event.repository.private` reference — but NOT as a job condition. It
# appears only inside `runs-on`, choosing the self-hosted pool over
# `ubuntu-latest`. Nothing here is gated on visibility, and nothing should be:
# a tlisp caixa's delivery is the TAG on the repo's own remote (the manifest's
# :files entries carry each shipped file's :sha256/:size/:body), never a
# crates.io publish, so a private repo releasing is a fully supported path, not
# a leak. Rows 1 and 2 therefore pin the OPPOSITE of cargo-auto-release's row 3:
# public and private must BOTH deliver. If a publish job is ever added behind
# `&& !private`, row 2 turns it into a NOT-RUN/NEVER finding instead of a green
# tick, which is the whole point of writing the posture down.
# WHAT THIS TABLE CANNOT ASSERT — read before trusting a green.
# `release` is the workflow's ONLY job, and the bump/no-bump distinction lives
# entirely at STEP level (`if: steps.bump.outputs.bumped == 'true'` on both the
# commit-and-tag step and the push step). job-selection-lint evaluates job `if:`
# only, so the no-bump path is modelled here as documentation of the scenario,
# not as a verified claim: in row 3 the linter checks that the JOB still selects
# (a re-run of an unchanged main is a green no-op, never version churn) and says
# nothing at all about whether the tag steps skipped. `steps.bump.outputs.bumped`
# and `github.event.repository.private` are declared in every row for the same
# reason — they name the input the row varies — but neither is read by any job
# condition today. The single path any `if:` here actually touches is
# `github.actor`.
# Public repo, something changed since the last tag: bump → commit → tag → push.
public-bump-tags-and-pushes
# THE PRIVACY ROW, and it is deliberately the inverse of cargo-auto-release's.
# A private caixa MUST still release. Visibility routes the runner and nothing
# else; a green run that quietly delivered nothing would be the defect.
private-bump-still-releases
# Nothing moved in source-paths. caixa-bump reports bumped=false, the job still
# runs and exits green having tagged nothing. Job-level only — see the caveat
# above; the step-level skip is outside this linter's scope.
no-bump-is-a-green-no-op
# The loop guard, and the only expect-skip in the table. The job pushes a
# release commit as the bot; without `github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'`
# that push retriggers this workflow, which bumps again, forever.
bot-actor-no-release-loop
